children: may test resistance at $102.88 per barrel, following its stabilization around a support and a rising trendline.
The stabilization indicates either the completion of the correction from $106.75, or a resumption of the uptrend from $79.62.
Another possibility is the first part of the correction has completed. A break above $102.88 may lead to a gain into $103.74-$104.59 range.
On the daily chart, the correction from $106.75 might have been driven by a wave 4, the fourth wave of a five-wave cycle from $79.62.

This wave is supposed to be weak, considering that preceding wave 2 was very brief. The long-shadowed hammer on Thursday indicates the completion of the wave 4, or its first part. A bounce on Friday and next Monday would be highly likely.
